comment: E’s narrower, two-layer GRU beat A’s wider, single-layer GRU under RMSprop .003 for 512 steps. I overvalued the wider, shallower route; reduced fitting of irrelevant context is plausible, but the gold ranking cannot distinguish generalization from optimization effects. K1017 helped with D<B<C; K1075 did not resolve E versus A, and K1016 cautioned against capacity-based selection. Backtesting found narrower/deeper wins in only 2/7 exact shared-optimizer history comparisons, both high-progress AdamW recipes. Lab checks found 5/17 wins, mostly near initialization; all eight trained Adam comparisons favored wider/shallow, with no matched RMSprop pairs. Thus this is a scoped counterexample, not evidence for a universal depth or width reversal.
